newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks ease in London in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks ease in London in thin trading.

text.p: Most Hong Kong stocks eased in London in thin trading, muted by the closure of U.S. markets. "There's no real direction because there's no Wall Street today," said one London broker. "Everyone is avoiding trading."
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was off 13.86 points at 11,092.71 at 1335 GMT.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng Index closed 52.45 points lower at 11,106.57 amid worries about higher interest rates.
In otherwise featureless dealings, shares in Hong Kong banks fell on profit-taking following their recent rise.
"Other than a bit of profit-taking in the bank sector, there's nothing," the broker added.
